TRIXX Technologies division

TRIXX Property Management

Helping landlords and property managers simplify rental operations, track payment records and maintain clearer records.

The opportunity

Problems worth solving.

Rental information can be spread across records and conversations. This division explores ways to make recurring property tasks easier to organize and review.

Who we aim to serve

Landlords and property managers seeking more organized property, tenancy and maintenance records.

Areas of focus

What this division is exploring.

  • 01Property and unit management
  • 02Tenant records
  • 03Rent schedules and payment tracking
  • 04Arrears monitoring
  • 05Receipts and statements
  • 06Maintenance requests
  • 07Lease and payment reminders
  • 08Expense tracking
  • 09M-Pesa integration as a planned capability

Payment records must not be confused with confirmed payments. M-Pesa integration is planned, not represented as implemented. TRIXX will never request or store a tenant’s M-Pesa PIN. These items describe focus or development areas, not a claim that products or services are already operational.
